title: Not Black, White & Brown....
text:
Not Black, White & Brown..... There is NO black in the design of this rug. I am very disappointed with how it looks upon arrival compared to the picture on line. While the rug feels substantial and looks nice, it is NOT woven in the colors that I expected. The photo showed it contained a lot of BLACK and the description uses the word "zebra". ZEBRAS ARE BLACK AND WHITE, which I assumed the majority of the rug would be. But, he entire rug is done in several colors of brown, tan and cream.
That said, it obviously does not go match the color scheme in the area where I wanted to place it, and I will send it back.
